Implement FP8 per-token-head KV cache where a float32 scale is stored inline immediately after each head's FP8 data, with stride padded to head_dim + 16 (16B aligned). Covers prefill and decode for single/batch, paged/ragged, MHA/GQA.

Kernel changes:

  • Add AttentionVariant::use_per_token_head flag for compile-time scale-aware dispatch
  • Decode: multiply float32 scales after cast_load in compute_qk and update_local_state, with async scale load pipelined alongside KV
  • page_produce_kv_sf_pth / produce_kv_sf_pth: load inline scales from global memory into shared memory (requires sizeof(DTypeKV) == 1)
  • Conditional scale smem via empty-base-class inheritance to avoid SM75 head_dim=256 overflow (49,152B standard vs 45,148B FP8-PTH)

Launcher changes:

  • batch_attention plan: resolve kernel pointer at plan time via get_persistent_kernel to pass smem_size to TwoStageHolisticPlan

Python API:

  • Add use_per_token_head param to single_prefill/decode, batch prefill/decode, and BatchAttention wrappers; forces backend="fa2" when enabled
  • Update JIT URI and AOT generator to emit per-token-head variants for FP8 KV

Other:

  • scheduler.cuh: fix int64→uint32 narrowing with static_cast for CUDA 13
    • GCC 14 (PartitionPagedKVCacheBinarySearchMinNumPagePerBatch)

Tests: all pass across 10 files (include 4 new files) covering jit/non-jit, paged/ragged, fp16/bf16, fp8_e4m3, MHA/GQA, head_dim 64/128/256, NHD/HND, ROPE_LLAMA, causal and large-batch.

📌 Description

Add fp8 per-token-head inline scale kv cache quantization.

Code Review

This pull request introduces support for FP8 per-token-head (PTH) inline scales across FlashInfer's attention kernels, including batch attention, single/batch decode, and single/batch prefill. The changes span CUDA kernel implementations, JIT bindings, Python API wrappers, and comprehensive unit tests. The review feedback highlights opportunities to improve safety and performance: specifically, guarding the else branches in page_produce_kv_sf_pth and produce_kv_sf_pth with if (smem_in_bounds) to avoid passing out-of-bounds shared memory pointers, and vectorizing the slow Python loops used to copy scale bytes in the test suites.

208-221: 💤 Low value

Consider gating scale loads on a single thread per warp.

All bdx threads redundantly load the same scale values since the destination scale_smem offset depends only on (ty, tz), not tx. While this is correct (all threads write the same value), it issues bdx redundant global memory loads per scale.

Gating on tx == 0 would reduce memory traffic:

feat: add FP8 per-token-head KV cache with inline float32 scales
192a190 
Implement FP8 per-token-head KV cache where a float32 scale is stored inline
immediately after each head's FP8 data, with stride padded to head_dim + 16
(16B aligned). Covers prefill and decode for single/batch, paged/ragged,
MHA/GQA.

Kernel changes:
  - Add AttentionVariant::use_per_token_head flag for compile-time scale-aware
    dispatch
  - Prefill: apply per-row scales in compute_qk/compute_sfm_v after ldmatrix,
    with BF16/FP16-aware upcast via __float2bfloat16_rn/__float2half_rn
  - Decode: multiply float32 scales after cast_load in compute_qk and
    update_local_state, with async scale load pipelined alongside KV
  - page_produce_kv_sf_pth / produce_kv_sf_pth: load inline scales from
    global memory into shared memory (requires sizeof(DTypeKV) == 1)
  - Conditional scale smem via empty-base-class inheritance to avoid SM75
    head_dim=256 overflow (49,152B standard vs 45,148B FP8-PTH)

Launcher changes:
  - single_decode: relax CHECK_INPUT → CHECK_CUDA for k/v since PTH stride
    (head_dim+16) makes is_contiguous() return false
  - batch_attention plan: resolve kernel pointer at plan time via
    get_persistent_kernel to pass smem_size to TwoStageHolisticPlan

Python API:
  - Add use_per_token_head param to single_prefill/decode, batch prefill/decode,
    and BatchAttention wrappers; forces backend="fa2" when enabled
  - Update JIT URI and AOT generator to emit per-token-head variants for FP8 KV

Other:
  - scheduler.cuh: fix int64→uint32 narrowing with static_cast for CUDA 13
    + GCC 14 (PartitionPagedKVCacheBinarySearchMinNumPagePerBatch)

Tests: all pass across 10 files (include 4 new files) on sm75 and sm86, covering
jit/non-jit, paged/ragged, fp16/bf16, fp8_e4m3, MHA/GQA, head_dim 64/128/256,
NHD/HND, ROPE_LLAMA, causal and large-batch.
